categories.haptics-exoskeleton: Haptic feedback suits, exoskeleton hardware & actuators

repos.name: HSMR
repos.description: Reconstructing Humans with a Biomechanically Accurate Skeleton (CVPR 2025 Oral)
repos.notes: Direct image/video -> biomechanical skeleton path; high rehab relevance. Front-end of pipeline/ (adapters/hsmr_to_skelseq.py). Needs the gated SKEL model (skel.is.tue.mpg.de) and its checkpoint from HuggingFace. Quirk: demo resizes inputs with (H, W) passed as (W, H) — a 3840x2160 video runs at 1080x608; the adapter replicates this.

repos.name: SKEL-CF

repos.name: pose2sim
repos.description: Markerless kinematics with any cameras — from 2D pose estimation to 3D OpenSim motion
repos.notes: Best-documented open path: cameras -> OpenSim kinematics. Strong rehab candidate. Used by pipeline/ (rehabtwin): Model_Pose2Sim_muscles_flex.osim + Markers_SKEL.xml/Markers_Mediapipe.xml. Known issue (2026-10-21): the 7 head markers in Markers_SKEL.xml carry torso-frame coordinates (top of head ~0.5 m too high); rehabtwin re-expresses them (configs/skel105_pose2sim.json).

repos.name: EasyMocap

repos.notes: Clinician-scored exercise quality (KIMORE includes patients) — core for the correction layer. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

repos.notes: Generates a 'corrected' movement to show the patient. MUST be constrained by SKEL/OpenSim joint limits; diffusion alone can produce anatomically impossible motion. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

repos.name: opensim-moco
repos.description: OpenSim Moco — solve optimal control problems for musculoskeletal models with direct collocation (muscle activity for observed/corrected motion, motion prediction)
repos.notes: Standalone repo is ARCHIVED; development moved into opensim-core (already catalogued). Listed so the capability is discoverable. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): Apache-2.0. ARCHIVED upstream (read-only).

repos.name: OpenSimRT
repos.description: OpenSimRT — real-time musculoskeletal kinematics and dynamics analysis using marker- and IMU-based solutions
repos.notes: Real-time biofeedback path (e.g. gait retraining) on top of OpenSim. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): GPL-3.0.

repos.name: CEINMS

repos.name: sofa

repos.name: OpenExo
repos.description: OpenExo — open-source modular exoskeleton platform for mobility and rehabilitation research: mechanical designs, electronics, firmware, control and biofeedback schemes

repos.name: opensourceleg

repos.notes: Lower-limb actuator/sensor control stack; prosthesis-first but transferable to exo legs. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): LGPL-2.1.

repos.name: senseshift-firmware

repos.name: lucidgloves

repos.notes: Hand-rehab niche only; not a body/posture solution. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): MIT.

repos.name: moteus

repos.name: Arduino-FOC

repos.name: TotalSegmentator

repos.name: nnUNet

repos.name: Slicer

repos.name: scalismo

repos.name: msk-PIPE

repos.name: thin-plate-spline_personalised_muscoloskeletal_model

repos.notes: Evidence-driven alternative to generic scaling; published comparison shows generic scaling can misplace e.g. the knee centre by centimetres. License: not declared in GitHub API metadata (2026-10-21) — check upstream repo.

repos.name: librealsense
repos.description: RealSense SDK 2.0 (librealsense) — official cross-platform driver/library for RealSense depth cameras including the D455; includes pyrealsense2 and ROS wrappers

repos.name: kalibr
repos.description: Kalibr — visual-inertial calibration toolbox for cameras and IMUs
repos.notes: Extrinsic/intrinsic calibration for the selected hardware (cameras + D455 IMU). Accuracy of everything downstream is bounded by this step. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

repos.name: apriltag
repos.description: AprilTag — visual fiducial marker system for robotics (pose of tagged objects from camera images)
repos.notes: Known-geometry fiducials for extrinsic calibration checks and validation-rig ground truth (docs/validation-protocol.md). License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

repos.name: Meshroom
repos.description: Meshroom — node-based photogrammetry toolbox (AliceVision) for 3D reconstruction from photos
repos.notes: Higher-resolution static surface reconstruction from the RGB cameras than iPhone LiDAR; subject must hold still — breathing/movement is the accuracy limit. License (GitHub API, 2026-10-21): NOASSERTION.

repos.name: opencap-monocular
repos.description: OpenCap Monocular — 3D human kinematics and musculoskeletal dynamics from a single smartphone video (WHAM pose, camera/pose optimisation, OpenSim IK and export)
repos.notes: Best-validated single-phone path to OpenSim found so far: preprint arXiv 2603.24733 reports 4.8 deg mean absolute error vs marker mocap for walking, squats and sit-to-stand. Its validation code reads the OpenCap LabValidation dataset (videos + marker-mocap IK). License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; needs SMPL weights (MPI, non-commercial). Benchmark rehabtwin's monocular front-ends against it.

repos.name: Sports2D
repos.description: Sports2D — joint and segment angles from a single video (RTMPose), with optional OpenSim inverse kinematics
repos.notes: Same author as Pose2Sim; BSD-3-Clause. Planar (2D) angles are only valid when the movement plane faces the camera — useful for quick sagittal screening, not for frontal/transverse posture. Ships a demo video.
